metadata.name: Empire Development Tree
metadata.description: Four-branch radial empire passive tree. Central axis: tier milestone decision capstones. Branches: Architect (NE), Explorer (SE), Treasury (SW), Artisan (NW).

data.name: Foundations of the Empire
data.description: Choose one empire-wide capstone as you enter Tier 1.

options.name: The Delver
options.description: Reduces the number of days to clear a dungeon by 5, to a minimum of 1.

options.name: The Hoarder
options.description: Loot rarity increased by 25% and quantity by 100%.

data.name: Edicts of Power
data.description: Choose one empire-wide capstone as you enter Tier 2.

options.name: The Sentinel
options.description: All cities gain 10% damage reduction against the Cataclysm type with the most dungeons in that city.

options.name: The Soul Forge
options.description: When improving an item level, 15% chance to increase by 2 instead of 1, up to max of 10.

data.name: The Imperial Vanguard
data.description: Choose one empire-wide capstone as you enter Tier 3.

options.name: The Warlord
options.description: When you clear a dungeon, 15% chance to instantly remove another dungeon in the same city.

options.name: The Master Tinkerer
options.description: When enchanting, 5% chance to hit a critical success, doubling the rolls and completing the craft instantly.

data.name: The Imperial Zenith
data.description: Choose one empire-wide capstone as you enter Tier 4.

options.name: Imperial Prowess
options.description: You can now take an additional keystone from any of the previous tiers.

options.name: The Last Stand
options.description: When you enter a dungeon in a city within 7 days of falling, run time is reduced to one day.

options.name: The Flood Barrier
options.description: Add 20 days to the surge timer. This applies to every surge.
